_about: Paño's brain for Pebblewick Pottery, the kit's example site (a made-up studio). Made from kit/templates/brain.json. Every line not written here comes from base.json. kit/BRAIN.md lists every field.

lines.name: Pip
lines.hello: Hi, I’m {cat_name}, the studio cat! I can show you around. What would you like to see?

menu.ask: What would you like to see?
menu.bye: Okay! I’ll be by the kiln if you need me.

background.ask: Which background would you like behind the pots?

make._why: Only the home page has the gallery.
make.label: What do you make?

steps.say: These are the three things we make most: mugs, bowls and planters.
Everything is made in the room behind the shop. Come and watch on a Saturday!

join-here._why: Classes have their own page. On the home page, this tour points the way there; on classes.html, the tour below (with the same label) shows the form.
join-here.label: How do I join a class?

steps.say: Classes are on their own page. Click Classes up here, then ask me again there and I’ll show you the sign-up form.

join.label: How do I join a class?

steps.say: Here are this month’s classes. Pick the one you like.
Then fill in your name and email here.
Choose your class, and press Sign me up. We’ll write back within a day.

visit._why: Every page has the footer, so this tour has no "pages".
visit.label: When can I visit?

steps.say: We’re open Thursday to Sunday, 10 to 4. The address is here too.
Or write to us here. We answer every email.
